get.summary: List tenant discrepancy and incident filter presets
get.description: Returns the built-in `critical_open`, `needs_review`, and `all` presets, overlaid with presets persisted for the resolved tenant. The current handler falls back to tenant id `default` when no tenant context is resolved; production callers must ensure an authenticated tenant context is present. This GET operation reads presets and does not create or update a custom preset.

post.summary: Create or replace a tenant filter preset
post.description: Accepts an optional JSON object with optional `name` and `filters` fields. The name defaults to `custom_preset` when omitted or empty; a whitespace-only name is rejected after trimming. `filters` defaults to an empty object. The handler upserts by resolved tenant and preset name and returns HTTP 201 with `status: saved` and the merged preset map. If no tenant context is resolved, the current handler falls back to tenant id `default`. The route decorator requires `read:discrepancies`; when API authentication is required, the write path also checks `write:discrepancies`.
